unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #2 on paultimfv/how-organic-is-x402: "A feeless Nano (XNO) rail is the case where organic is re-derivable from the ledger itself". Framed in its organic-vs-gamed measurement terms: on a Nano rail every send is one public final block any stranger re-derives, no allowance/nonce/batching/facilitator to fudge the numerator; offered nano-info (0.0005) as a read-side tool; disclosed public research. Verified OPEN, author dhyabi2, Nano+XNO in body.
